newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU clears daily bids for 70,000 T wheat - ONIC.
newsitem.headline: EU clears daily bids for 70,000 T wheat - ONIC.

text.p: The European Union has accepted bids submitted through a daily channel for 70,000 tonnes of soft wheat exports with a "nil value" licence, France's grain office ONIC said on Monday.
The bids were submitted last Wednesday through France, it said.
On Friday exporters also submitted bids via France to export 39,875 tonnes of soft wheat with "nil value" licences.
The Commission has a three-day right of veto over such bids.

The decision to accept the bids for 70,000 tonnes of wheat came as the EU shut the tender for exports through the weekly tender channel last Thursday, a move which all but closes the July/June export campaign.
The daily system remains open with a "nil value" refund, meaning traders can take out short-validity licences whose value can be changed before they are used.
